2026 buyer guide for operations teams

AI agents for the systems your business already uses

Choose one task that ends in a visible action, such as updating an order or routing a support case. Then compare the agent platforms that can complete it.

Find a match for my project

What to ask before you buy

  1. Give each vendor the same ten representative tasks and record which actions complete correctly.
  2. Repeat the test as a user with fewer permissions. Check both data visibility and write access.
  3. Interrupt a workflow halfway through. Inspect retries, duplicate records and the human handoff.

Run a trial before giving an agent write access

Use a sandbox CRM and a test inbox to see which actions an agent takes, what it records and when it asks for help.

Directory

This list covers CRM, ERP, cloud and cross-app workflows. AY Automate appears as an implementation service for teams that want help building their workflow.

Published by AY Automate, which sells AI implementation services. Entries link to provider materials. The guide gives no numerical ratings.

Microsoft workflows

Microsoft Copilot Studio

Provides tools to build agents. Test access with two employees who have different permissions on the same document.

Source from Microsoft Copilot Studio

CRM operations

Salesforce Agentforce

Runs agents on the Salesforce platform. Ask which CRM records an agent can update and how those changes appear in the audit trail.

Source from Salesforce Agentforce

Cloud engineering

Google Cloud Agent Builder

Provides services to build and manage agents on Google Cloud. Budget for the people who will operate the deployment.

Cloud engineering

Amazon Bedrock Agents

Connects model-driven actions with application resources. Use an account with narrow permissions for the pilot.

How to compare prices

Ask for a quote at your expected task volume. Include platform seats, model calls, action or connector charges and human review. Divide the total by successfully completed tasks.

A worked example to review

Zapier’s documentation shows how actions connect an agent to other apps. Use one documented action as the starting point for a two-system trial.

Read the provider’s example

Can an agent update production records?

That depends on the connector, its credentials and the actions you enable. Start with a draft or approval step so the system owner can inspect the proposed change.
